title: Below 342 CSS px the header bar overflows by 22px: on a phone every page opens shifted, the reading-start edge cut, and it pans sideways; on desktop zoom «القائمة» is clipped
evidence: Measured on the 2026-10-07 01:30 export (pages.mjs, w320.mjs): at 320px every page in the slice (and the 404) has documentElement.scrollWidth 342 vs clientWidth 320; the only element outside is BUTTON.site-module__menuButton at [-22,89]. The .bar (site.module.css:16-24) is a nowrap flex row of the brand (Mark + «أنس» + «anas.studio», 191px wide, none can shrink) and the menu button (111px, margin-inline-end calc(var(--gutter) * -1 + 8px)) with gap 20px. With touch emulation (isMobile) Chrome widens the layout viewport to 342 (innerWidth 342, scrollX -22, visualViewport.pageLeft -22): main spans [22,342] in a 320px visual viewport, so the right 22px of every band, the RTL reading start, is off-screen and the page pans sideways (shots/w320-cdp-mobile.png: «المجلس» and the photo cut at the right edge, a sand strip on the left). Without touch (200% zoom of a 640px window, 400% of 1280) body overflow-x: clip keeps scrollX 0 and the button is cut instead: «القائمة» reads «القائم» (shots/w320-cdp-desktop.png).
impact: On any phone or zoom level narrower than 342 CSS px (320px phones, Android "large display size", 400% zoom on a 1280 window, WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow) every public page opens with the first letters of each right-aligned line hidden and wobbles sideways under the thumb; at desktop zoom the only navigation control below 1024px shows a clipped label. The visual suite tests 360 and up, so nothing catches it.
proposed_fix: Let the brand give way on narrow bars: hide .brandDomain below 22rem (e.g. @media (max-width: 21.3rem) { .brandDomain { display: none } }) or give .brand min-inline-size: 0 with the domain allowed to drop; then add 320 to the visual suite widths so the reflow case stays covered.
prior_overlap: Not reported by AUDIT-1, AUDIT-2 or tasmeem (they measured 360+). TEST-E2E-08 (wave B) notes no 320px run exists; this is the concrete defect that gap hides.

title: A journal post title with a long Latin run (or a long Arabic word at 320) breaks the article page on phones: the h1 has no overflow-wrap, unlike RoomHero and the store heads
evidence: The export has no published post, so article.mjs rebuilds PostView's markup (same elements and CSS-module classes, read from the live stylesheets) on /journal after hydration. Title «دليل الـFranchising للمطاعم الصغيرة» at 360 with touch emulation: h1 scrollWidth 452 vs clientWidth 320, documentElement.scrollWidth 472, innerWidth 472; the article header spans [112,472] (shots/article-longword-360-top.png: the page opens shifted, the Latin word runs out of the saffron band over the sand, the brand and every line start cut off at the right). «عن الاستراتيجيات والمستثمرين» already overflows its box at 360 (scrollWidth 336 vs 320, absorbed by the gutter), so it passes the viewport edge at 320. .postTitle (journal.module.css:165-168) sets only margin and size; room-hero.module.css:16 and store.module.css:24-26 carry overflow-wrap: anywhere for exactly this case («A title with one long unbreakable run ... wraps instead of scrolling the page sideways»).
impact: Anas writes about the food business; a title with an English loanword (Franchising, Branding, Cloud Kitchen) at the post title's 68px phone size makes that post's page open sideways-shifted on every phone, with the start of each line hidden and horizontal panning, until the title is edited. Nothing in the admin warns him.
proposed_fix: Add overflow-wrap: anywhere to .postTitle, as RoomHero's title has; the same line belongs on the journal card titles (.cardBody h2) and RoomNav's .name, which print the same titles at 44px and 36px.
prior_overlap: None: AUDIT-1, AUDIT-2 and tasmeem could not render a post (none published; tasmeem skipped /journal/<slug>).

title: In the export the post title never takes its own size: the module rule loses to the global .t-title, so --size-post-title is dead and titles run about 22% larger than designed
evidence: The post route itself does too: out/journal/_.html (rendered by journal/[slug]/page.tsx) links 37lmkiv9a5z5_.css, 3m_iako6q6ww8.css, 2vjn7irm_-gm2.css in that order, so a real post page gets the same cascade. Every exported public page links the component-module chunk before globals.css: out/journal.html, index, book, contact, scenes, 404, policies/store and store load 37lmkiv9a5z5_.css (holds journal-module__-XRgIq__postTitle{font-size:var(--size-post-title)}) and then 3m_iako6q6ww8.css (holds .t-title{font-size:var(--size-title);line-height:1.25}). Both selectors are one class, so the later .t-title wins. Measured on the rebuilt post header (article.mjs): h1 font-size 68px at 320/360 and 178.56px at 1440 (= --size-title, clamp(68px, 12.4vw, 200px)), not 56px / 144px (--size-post-title, clamp(56px, 10vw, 168px)); a 45-character title is 5 lines (425px) at 360 and 670px tall at 1440 (shots/article-360.png, article-1440.png). cascade.mjs over out/**/*.html finds a second live instance of the same inversion: shelf-module__soon + .t-quote, where the module's font-weight 500 loses to 400 on /shelf.
impact: Post titles render at page-title size, so a long title takes an extra line on phones and the saffron band fills the first screen. More generally, any module rule that tunes a text role's size, weight or leading is silently ignored in the export, so a design change reviewed in another environment can differ in production.
proposed_fix: Make the text roles yield to component modules whatever the chunk order: wrap the .t-* rules in globals.css in :where() (zero specificity) or put them in a cascade layer (@layer roles { ... }); then re-check the post title and the shelf .soon line.
prior_overlap: None. tasmeem round 2 (row 16) introduced --size-post-title; nothing measured it on a built post.

title: In a post, a quotation is set exactly like a section heading (same face, weight and 30-50px size), so a short quote reads as a heading and a long one becomes a wall of display type
evidence: .prose h2 (journal.module.css:197-206) and .prose blockquote (211-218) are both Thmanyah Serif Display 500 at var(--size-display); the quote has no rule, indent, mark or colour of its own (margin-inline 0, padding-inline-start 0). Measured on the rebuilt post at 1440 (article.mjs): H2 48.96px/68.5px, BLOCKQUOTE 48.96px/75.9px, same width 690. In shots/article-1440-quotes.png the one-line quote «الطبق باب، والرائحة طريق.» is indistinguishable from the h2 «من المطبخ إلى الفكرة» above it, and a 45-word quotation runs 7 lines of 50px display type (531px tall), heavier than every heading of the article.
impact: Readers of المجلس cannot tell a quoted line from a new section; a quoted paragraph from someone else visually outranks Anas's own headings. Screen readers are unaffected (it is a real blockquote).
proposed_fix: Give .prose blockquote the book page's quotation treatment (book.module.css:102-139: thin rules above and below, the saffron-ink guillemets with the opening one hanging) or at least a step down to --size-quote with an inline-start rule, so headings keep the display size to themselves.
prior_overlap: None (no post was ever rendered by the earlier audits).

title: The rich-text renderer drops each block's direction, so an English paragraph or quote in a post shows its full stop on the wrong side («.Good food is a promise kept»)
evidence:
renderNode returns

,

/

,
and
  • with no dir (richtext.tsx:39-48, 63); src/admin/richtext.ts notes that Lexical stores per-block bookkeeping (direction, format, indent) and keeps it loose, so the stored direction is never used. In the rebuilt post (article.mjs) the paragraph «Good food is a promise kept.» inherits dir=rtl (computed direction rtl, align start) and renders as «.Good food is a promise kept» with the period at its left edge (shots/article-360-crop-lists.png). The editor shows the same block left to right, so what Anas previews differs from what the site prints.
impact: Any English sentence, quote or code-like line Anas puts on its own line in a post is printed with its punctuation moved to the wrong end; mixed lines keep working because the paragraph stays RTL.
proposed_fix: In renderNode, pass the stored direction through: dir={node.direction === 'ltr' ? 'ltr' : undefined} on paragraph, heading, quote and listitem (what Lexical showed the author), rather than dir="auto", which would also flip Arabic paragraphs that open with a Latin brand name.

title: Bold inside a post heading or quotation is synthesised: Thmanyah Serif Display has no 700 face, and .prose strong asks for 700
evidence: globals.css declares Serif Display at 400 and 500 only (lines 5-16); .prose strong sets font-weight 700 (journal.module.css:226-228) and the editor offers bold everywhere, headings and quotes included (RichTextEditor.tsx:141). In the rebuilt post the h3 «حساب التكلفة قبل التسعير» with «قبل» bold computes STRONG font="Thmanyah Serif Display" 700, and the word is drawn with browser faux bold (shots/article-1440-h3-bold.png: thickened strokes, heavier than the rest of the line). The same happens to bold words in a quotation. The tasmeem audit records zero faux bold on Arabic as a property to keep.
impact: Emphasis inside a heading or quote is drawn by smearing the display face, which coarsens Arabic joins at 30-50px, on a site whose identity is its type.
proposed_fix: Scope the bold: .prose :is(h2, h3, blockquote) strong { font-weight: inherit } (the display face already carries emphasis), or add font-synthesis-weight: none to the display roles and let the medium weight stand.

title: The scenes lightbox never fits a photo to the screen: on desktop, tablet and a phone held sideways most photos spill far past the stage, showing only their top and covering the caption
evidence: .photo sets max-block-size: 100% (scenes.module.css:199-205), but the img is a grid item of .stage (192-198: display grid, place-items center, no grid-template-rows), whose only row is auto, so the percentage is indefinite and ignored. lightbox.mjs steps through all 19 photos: photo taller or wider than its stage on 17/19 at 1440x900 (first photo 1267x2253 in a 1440x758 stage), 19/19 at 1280x720, 16/19 at 1024x768, 12/19 at 768x1024, 19/19 on a phone in landscape 844x390, 0/19 only on a 360x720 portrait phone. The caption under the photo is painted over (elementFromPoint at the caption returns the img) on 16/19, 18/19, 15/19, 8/19 and 19/19 of those, and the dialog itself scrolls (scrollHeight 2321 vs 900 at 1440x900). shots/lightbox-1440x900.png and shots/scenes-1440-lightbox.png show the Street No. 4 sign photo as a band of sky with the caption hidden; shots/lightbox-844x390.png the same on a phone held sideways.
impact: The page's one interaction, «تكبير», shows most of Anas's photographs cut to their top third on laptops, desktops and tablets, with the caption (also the photo's alt and title) hidden behind the image and the step arrows covering only the visible part; a visitor has to scroll inside the dialog to see the rest.
proposed_fix: Give the stage a definite track so the image can size against it, e.g. .stage { grid-template: minmax(0, 1fr) / minmax(0, 1fr) } with .photo { inline-size: 100%; block-size: 100%; object-fit: contain } (or position the img absolutely in .stage with inset: 0; margin: auto); then measure every photo at 1440x900 and 844x390 in the e2e lightbox test. sizes="100vw" can then become the real stage width.
prior_overlap: None. AUDIT-1 X3.14 (step arrows' backing on phones) and tasmeem rows 13, 20, 21 touched the lightbox; the photo sizing has been unchanged since 2f54f85 and the e2e lightbox test asserts keyboard and counter, not layout.

title: The book page's editions are hard-coded as «قريباً» with «السعر يُعلن قريباً» and link nowhere: once the store sells the book, Anas's own book page contradicts it and gives no way to buy, and he cannot change it from the admin
evidence: BookView.tsx:236-238 prints the section heading «قريباً» and :252-255 a price row «السعر» / «يُعلن قريباً» under every edition, in code; the rooms/book document (src/admin/collections/rooms.ts:247-250, 286-287) gives an edition only `name` and `text`, with no price, product or link field. book.mjs on the export: main a[href^="/store"] count 0 on /book at 360 and 1440; the hero's first action «النسخ ←» (BookView.tsx:86) jumps to #editions, which ends in the two «السعر يُعلن قريباً» panels (shots/book-360-editions.png). The P08 store already carries the book as a product (/store/demo-khous), and no package (P08-CONTRACT, WORK-PACKAGES P08-P11) mentions the book page's editions.
impact: On the day checkout opens with Anas's prices, the page every book link leads to still says the price will be announced soon and ends without a path to the product, so readers who arrive at /book (the home door, the reader's last leaf «بقية الحكاية في الكتاب», the nav) are told it is not for sale; fixing the words needs a code change and a deploy, against C12 (the owner manages everything visible).
proposed_fix: Give each edition an optional product slug (or link) in bookEditionFields and render, when set, the catalog price and an ActionLink to /store/<slug> in place of the price row; keep «يُعلن قريباً» only for an edition without a product, and make the section heading a CMS field (or derive «قريباً» from «no edition on sale»).
prior_overlap: None. DESIGN.md §8 records «يُعلن قريباً» as the truthful state before prices exist; nothing plans the switch.

title: The book page's <title> is hard-coded, so it drifts from the h1 as soon as Anas edits the book's title, subtitle or room label in the admin
evidence: book/page.tsx:6 exports `metadata = { title: 'كتبتُ هنا: خوص | حكايات شارع 4' }`, while BookView renders book.roomLabel, book.title and book.subtitle from the rooms/book document (BookView.tsx:68-77; rooms.ts:253-255 makes all three editable, D44). The exported title is «كتبتُ هنا: خوص | حكايات شارع 4 · أنس عبدالله القرني» (pages.mjs). AUDIT-1 X7.3 fixed the same drift on the policy pages by reading the published title in generateMetadata.
impact: Tabs, history, bookmarks and shared links keep the old book name after an edit, and P10's planned per-route metadata would start from a constant instead of the approved data.
proposed_fix: Replace the constant with generateMetadata() that reads getBookRoom() (React cache shares the fetch with the page) and builds `${roomLabel}: ${title} | ${subtitle}`.
prior_overlap: Same class as AUDIT-1 X7.3 (policies), which did not cover /book.

title: With JavaScript off the sticky header grows to 200px on a phone and stays pinned, covering about a third of the screen on every page
evidence: The scripting:none rules (site.module.css:99-110) wrap the bar and show every room link at every width, but .header keeps position: sticky (lines 2-6) and its hide-on-scroll is script. nojs.mjs / sticky.mjs on /contact, /journal, /scenes, the 404 and /policies/refund with javaScriptEnabled false: bar height 200px at 320 and 360 (68px at 1024); scrolled to 1200px on a 640px-tall screen the header still spans top 0 to bottom 200 with position sticky (shots/nojs-contact-360-scrolled.png: brand plus three rows of links over the content).
impact: Visitors without script on a phone read every page through a 440px window under a 200px band of links; at 200% zoom it is worse.
proposed_fix: Add `.header { position: static }` (or relative) inside the existing @media (scripting: none) block, so the wrapped link rows scroll away with the page.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 G5.2 added the wrapped JS-off links (holds); the sticky height was not considered.

title: No global-error file: an error thrown in the public root layout's client code (the header, the motion layer) shows Next's English «This page couldn’t load» page with no lang or dir
evidence: src/app has global-not-found.tsx but no global-error.tsx. Next.js 16.4 docs (https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/error): error.js «does not wrap the layout.js or template.js above it in the same segment. To handle errors in the root layout, use global-error.js». (public)/layout.tsx renders the client components SiteHeader (matchMedia, scroll and focus listeners) and MotionLayer (IntersectionObserver, MutationObserver, Element.animate) outside the (public)/error.tsx boundary. The installed next 16.3.5 falls back to node_modules/next/dist/client/components/builtin/global-error.js: `<html id="__next_error__">` with the English «This page couldn’t load», «Reload to try again, or go back.» and buttons «Reload» / «Back», no lang, no dir.
impact: A runtime exception in the header or the motion layer on some browser replaces the whole Arabic site with an English, left-to-right error card; the designed Arabic error page (Lost styling, «تعذّر عرض هذه الصفحة») is never shown for it.
proposed_fix: Add src/app/global-error.tsx ('use client', its own <html lang="ar" dir="rtl"> and minimal inline styles, the same wording as error.tsx and a retry()). Also switch error.tsx's button from reset() to retry(): next 16.3 made retry stable and documents it as the default, since it re-fetches the segment as well as re-rendering it.
prior_overlap: tasmeem row 36 reworded error.tsx (holds); the root-layout case was never covered.

title: At 320 CSS px the Turnstile widget (a fixed 300px) pushes the contact form into the left gutter, so its fields and the widget touch the screen edge
evidence: turnstile.render() passes no size (turnstile.ts:60-73), so the widget is «Normal: 300px width × 65px height» (https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/get-started/client-side-rendering/widget-configurations/). At 320 the form's room is 280px. contact320.mjs (header domain hidden so DSN-PAGES-01 does not mask it, touch emulation): with the widget blocked the form spans [20,300]; with the build's public test widget loaded it spans [0,300] w=300 (shots/contact-320-widget-domainhidden.png: the widget and the textarea flush with the left edge, while the channels below keep their gutter).
impact: On a 320px phone (or 400% zoom) the contact form loses its gutter on one side; nothing is cut, but the form no longer lines up with the page.
proposed_fix: Render size 'compact' (150x140) when the box is narrower than 300px (`size: el.clientWidth < 300 ? 'compact' : 'flexible'`; flexible also aligns the widget to the form's width above 300px).
prior_overlap: tasmeem row 31 set language and theme (holds); size was never set.

title: The contact form's two stop notices send visitors to «القنوات المجاورة», which are below the form on phones and absent altogether in the designed no-channels state
evidence: ContactForm.tsx:219 «التحقق من المرسل غير مُعدّ بعد، فالإرسال متوقف مؤقتاً. راسلني عبر القنوات المجاورة.» and :223 (noscript) «الإرسال يحتاج JavaScript؛ راسلني عبر القنوات المجاورة.» are unconditional; contact/page.tsx:47 renders the channel list only when WhatsApp or a social link is set, and DESIGN.md §8 names the state with no channels at all. On phones the list sits after the form (shots/contact-360.png), not beside it. ContactForm has no prop telling it whether channels exist.
impact: A visitor whose form is stopped (no script, or no Turnstile key) is told to use channels that may not be on the page; while I41's hosted bootstrap is pending they are not.
proposed_fix: Pass `hasChannels` from the page and say «راسلني عبر القنوات أدناه» only when it is true; otherwise drop the pointer (or name the published e-mail once I45 (3) is decided).
prior_overlap: EF-ACCESS-01 / PLAN-GAPS-09 (wave A/B) cover the unpublished contact e-mail; this is the form's own copy.

title: The 404's room links paint their unfilled cells solid aub-800, so on a phone the block ends in dark holes (the lattice defect AUDIT-2 fixed elsewhere)
evidence: .ways (lost.module.css:17-24) is a wrapping flex row with gap 1px, padding 1px and background var(--aub-800), so every row that does not fill the block shows the background. At 360 the seven links wrap 3-3-1 (pages.mjs): a 30px dark strip beside «بنيتُ هنا» and a 230px dark slab beside «المجلس» (shots/404-360-ways.png). AUDIT-2's orchestrator fixed the same pattern in layout.lattice («The tiles now draw the lines, in the band's own line colour»); Lost.tsx was not changed.
impact: The 404 is the page a mistyped or stale link lands on; on phones its way back looks broken and unfinished.
proposed_fix: Draw the lines on the links instead of the container (e.g. .ways { background: none; gap: 0 } .ways a { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--aub-800) } with a 1px negative margin), or let the last row's link grow (flex: 1 1 auto) so no cell is left empty.
prior_overlap: Same class as AUDIT-2 PUBLIC-style-10 / STORE-cart-8 (lattices), fixed there, not here.

title: /scenes with no published gallery (the first hosted build, per I41) shows a lone «الكل» filter and a 50vh wall of weave, and pushes «لا توجد مَشاهد بعد.» below the fold
evidence: scenes/page.tsx:18-23 renders <SceneGallery> whatever the item count and adds the message band after it. SceneGallery with items=[] still renders the filter group with [ALL] (SceneGallery.tsx:67-82), a status «الكل: 0 صور», the weave edge, an empty ul.grid whose min-block-size 50vh is painted with the weave tile (scenes.module.css:44-54), and a second weave edge. scenes-empty.mjs (the DOM emptied the same way on the export): grid 380px tall at 360x760 and 450px at 1440x900; the message starts at y=765 and y=1057, below the first screen in both (shots/scenes-empty-360.png, scenes-empty-1440.png), set in 17px body text. ISSUES I41 says the hosted project has no published scenes/gallery until the P11 bootstrap.
impact: Until the gallery is published (or whenever Anas hides every photo), visitors get a filter with nothing to filter and a decorative block that looks like a failed image grid, and must scroll to learn the page is empty; DESIGN-AUDIT 126/130 ask for a section waiting for material to be omitted.
proposed_fix: In scenes/page.tsx render SceneGallery only when items.length > 0; otherwise render the title band (as the journal's RoomHero) with the message in a visible role (e.g. t-lead), so the empty state reads like /journal's.
prior_overlap: DESIGN.md §8 and ISSUES I41 name the state; nobody rendered it.
